title: bromus barcensis var. romanicus
intro: Bromus barcensis var. romanicus, commonly known as Romano hard fescue or Romano soft fescue, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This perennial grass has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus barcensis var. romanicus involve its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
